prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: horizontal editorial cover photograph for a Spanish publication about AI and work
Primary request: a street-side bicycle courier paused at dusk, checking coins in one open hand after a delivery, conveying how automated decisions touch a person's pay.
Scene/backdrop: a believable European city street with a bicycle and softly blurred evening traffic, no company branding.
Style/medium: candid human-interest photojournalism, natural posture, realistic skin and weathered fabric, subtle 35mm film grain.
Composition/framing: cinematic 16:9 landscape crop, courier foreground, city lights soft behind, thoughtful rather than distressed.
Lighting/mood: dusk ambient light with a restrained red reflection from a distant traffic signal, deep but legible shadows.
Color palette: warm near-black, muted city neutrals, small red light accent, natural skin tones.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, respectful portrayal.
Avoid: office, paperwork, phone screens, robot imagery, staged stock-photo poses, dramatic misery.
